triples.tail_surface: testing and renewal of any sealing arrangements
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 密封装置的测试与更换
triples.evidence_text: Maintenance in service instructions to include testing and renewal of any sealing arrangements.

triples.tail_surface: lightweight spring-loaded valve discs or other quick-acting and self-closing devices
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 轻质弹簧加载阀盘或其他速动自关闭装置
triples.evidence_text: Crankcase explosion relief valves are to be provided with lightweight spring-loaded valve discs or other quick-acting and self-closing devices to relieve a crankcase of pressure in the event of an internal explosion and to prevent the inrush of air thereafter.

triples.head_surface: passage of flame following a crankcase explosion
triples.head_canonical_zh: 曲轴箱爆炸后的火焰传播
triples.evidence_text: Crankcase explosion relief valves are to be provided with a flame arrester that permits flow for crankcase pressure relief and prevents passage of flame following a crankcase explosion.
